external_entities.name: suppliers
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the SaaS portal, issues supplier credentials, and pushes the nightly extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

external_entities.name: category managers
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded supplier paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

processes.name: supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review it.

processes.name: supplier master service
processes.description: The service loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor platform where the supplier documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organisation's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes extracted records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers upload insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Suppliers sign in to the portal using credentials issued by the vendor.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: review submissions
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and associated supplier contact details

data_flows.name: push supplier extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." System description: "The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These claims do not establish one value for encryption in transit.

data_flows.name: load extract
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes the extracted records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract

trust_boundaries.name: vendor platform
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and supplier documents.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface because the text calls it a portal.
assumptions.basis: The source names the component "Supplier document portal" and describes suppliers signing in through it.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform holds confidential data because it stores compliance documents and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source says the platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket holds confidential data because it receives the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The source says the bucket receives a supplier data extract containing supplier records.
